'''Platform Trill 92''' was a facility that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==Description==
Platform Trill 92 had a only a limited number of facilities, which included a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] with an attached hotel, some repair facilities and an expensive general store.

==History==
During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] a group of Republic [[Agent/Legends|agents]] landed on Platform Trill 92 while en route to Nyriaan. Onboard the facility, they met with members of the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]], who fitted the agents [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with a [[laser transport array]] system, to allow it to land on Nyriaan.
